results.title: The role and impact of new technologies on healthcare systems
results.content: Emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), which refers to the simulation of human intelligence by machines, the Internet of Things (IoT), which involves interconnected devices that collect and exchange health-related data in real time, Blockchain, which is a decentralized and tamper-proof ledger technology used to securely manage patient data, and wearable devices are explored for their potential applications in diagnostics, treatment, and patient monitoring. Healthcare systems are rapidly evolving due to the adoption of advanced technologies such as the Internet of Things (IoT), machine learning (ML), a subset of AI focused on enabling machines to learn from data and improve their performance, artificial intelligence (AI), blockchain, and edge computing, which brings computational power closer to the source of data to enable faster processing and real-time analytics.
